t2.title: Learning a foreign language be compulsory in schools
t2.prompt: You are participating in an online discussion forum. The topic is: "Should learning a foreign language be compulsory in schools?" Write your response, giving reasons and examples. Write 180–200 words.
t2.sample:
Foreign language education is debated in many countries. I strongly believe language learning should be compulsory in schools.

Firstly, learning languages develops cognitive abilities. Research shows bilingual children have better problem-solving skills, improved memory, and enhanced critical thinking. These benefits extend beyond language itself.

Secondly, languages open career opportunities. In our globalized economy, employers value multilingual candidates. Speaking additional languages can lead to international positions and higher salaries.

However, critics argue that time could be spent on other subjects. Additionally, English dominance means many people don't need other languages. Nevertheless, this view is shortsighted.

Furthermore, language learning promotes cultural understanding. Students gain appreciation for different cultures, reducing prejudice and fostering global citizenship. This is increasingly important in diverse societies.

In conclusion, compulsory language education benefits individuals and society. Schools should introduce languages early when children learn most naturally.

t2.sampleB1:
Dear LinguaPro Team,

Thank you for asking about the app. I think the lessons are quite good, and the teaching methods are helpful. The exercises are helping me to improve my vocabulary and grammar.

I think learning a language is important in school. I think it can help you get a better job later. Also, it helps you understand other cultures. However, some people say it's not necessary. In my opinion, it should be compulsory. Maybe you could add more interactive exercises to the app. I also would like to see a German language option.

t2.sampleB2: Great question — this is something I feel really strongly about! For me, it's a definite yes. Learning a foreign language should absolutely be compulsory in schools, and here's why. First off, languages open doors. In today's job market, being able to speak more than one language gives you a real edge, whether you're applying for a job abroad or dealing with clients from overseas. Employers pick up on it straight away. On top of that, studying a language does wonders for the brain. It sharpens your memory and boosts your problem-solving skills — benefits that spill over into every other subject. I know some people argue that not everyone will use a second language, especially now that English is so widespread. Fair enough, but I reckon that misses the bigger picture: languages break down barriers and help us understand other cultures. At the end of the day, making languages compulsory sets young people up for a more connected future, and the earlier they start, the easier it comes. So what do you all think? Should it be compulsory right from primary school, or left as a choice? I'd love to hear your thoughts!
t2.uzSample:
Chet tillarni o'qitish ko'plab mamlakatlarda bahsga sabab bo'lmoqda. Men til o'rganish maktablarda majburiy bo'lishi kerak, deb qat'iy ishonaman.

Birinchidan, tillarni o'rganish kognitiv qobiliyatlarni rivojlantiradi. Tadqiqotlar shuni ko'rsatadiki, ikki tilli bolalar muammolarni hal qilishda yaxshiroq, xotirasi kuchliroq va tanqidiy fikrlash qobiliyati yuqori bo'ladi. Bu afzalliklar tilning o'zidan tashqari ham ta'sir qiladi.

Ikkinchidan, tillar kasbiy imkoniyatlarni ochadi. Global iqtisodiyotimizda ish beruvchilar ko'p tilli nomzodlarni qadrlashadi. Qo'shimcha tillarda gaplasha olish xalqaro lavozimlarga va yuqori maoshlarga olib kelishi mumkin.

Biroq, tanqidchilar vaqtni boshqa fanlarga sarflash mumkinligini ta'kidlashadi. Bundan tashqari, ingliz tilining ustunligi ko'p odamlarga boshqa tillar kerak emasligini anglatadi. Shunga qaramay, bu qarash uzoqni ko'zlamaydi.

Bundan tashqari, til o'rganish madaniy tushunishni rivojlantiradi. Talabalar turli madaniyatlarni qadrlashni o'rganadilar, bu esa xurofotni kamaytiradi va global fuqarolikni rivojlantiradi. Bu xilma-xil jamiyatlarda tobora muhim ahamiyat kasb etmoqda.

Xulosa qilib aytganda, majburiy til ta'limi shaxslarga ham, jamiyatga ham foyda keltiradi. Maktablar bolalar eng tabiiy ravishda o'rganadigan erta yoshda tillarni o'rgatishni boshlashlari kerak.

Menimcha, maktabda til o'rganish muhim. Menimcha, bu keyinchalik yaxshiroq ish topishingizga yordam berishi mumkin. Shuningdek, u boshqa madaniyatlarni tushunishga yordam beradi. Biroq, ba'zi odamlar buni zarur emas deyishadi. Mening fikrimcha, bu majburiy bo'lishi kerak. Ehtimol, ilovaga ko'proq interaktiv mashqlar qo'shishingiz mumkin. Men ham nemis tili variantini ko'rishni xohlardim.

Yana bir bor rahmat!
t2.uzSampleB2:
Hurmatli LinguaPro jamoasi,

LinguaPro ilovasi bilan bog'liq tajribam yuzasidan qo'shimcha ma'lumot so'raganingiz uchun rahmat. Umuman olganda, darslar yaxshi tuzilgan va qiziqarli ekanligini aniqladim. O'qitish usullari odatda samarali va mashqlar tilni tushunishimni mustahkamlashda foydali bo'lmoqda.

Maktablarda chet tilini o'rganish majburiy bo'lishi kerakmi degan kengroq savolga kelsak, menimcha, bu o'quv dasturining majburiy tarkibiy qismi bo'lishi kerak. Chet tilini o'rganish bir qator afzalliklarni taqdim etadi. Birinchidan, u kognitiv moslashuvchanlik va muammolarni hal qilish qobiliyatini oshiradi. Ikkinchidan, u madaniyatlararo tushunish va hamdardlikni rivojlantiradi, bu bizning o'zaro bog'langan dunyomizda tobora muhim ahamiyat kasb etmoqda. Ba'zilarning ta'kidlashicha, u boshqa muhim fanlardan chalg'itadi, ammo ko'p tillilikning shaxsiy va professional jihatdan afzalliklari kamchiliklardan ustundir. Bundan tashqari, tillarga erta ta'sir qilish ularni osonroq o'zlashtirishga yordam beradi. Ilova ichida suhbat amaliyoti uchun ko'proq imkoniyatlar qo'shishni taklif qilaman, ehtimol virtual almashinuv dasturlari orqali. Shuningdek, Mandarin yoki arab tillari kabi kamroq o'qitiladigan tillarni qo'llab-quvvatlashni ko'rishga qiziqardim.

Hurmat bilan,

t12.title: formal letter · to recipient
t12.prompt: Write a letter to the language learning app. Write about your feelings and what you think they should do.
t12.sample: Dear LinguaPro Team, Thank you for asking about my experience with your language learning app. I am thoroughly impressed with the platform. The bite-sized lessons fit perfectly into my busy schedule. The speech recognition feature has significantly improved my pronunciation. The gamification elements keep me motivated daily. However, I have some suggestions. The grammar explanations are sometimes too brief for complex topics. Additionally, the conversation practice with AI feels slightly unnatural. I would love to see more cultural content integrated into lessons. A live tutoring option with native speakers would be valuable. Also, adding business language courses would attract professional learners. Overall, LinguaPro has made learning enjoyable and effective. Yours sincerely, Muattar Salimova
t12.sampleA1:
Hi LinguaPro,
I like the app. It is good.
I learn English. The lessons are easy.
I want more words. Bye.
t12.sampleA2:
Hi LinguaPro,
I like your app because it is fun. The lessons are short and I learn new words. But the exercises are sometimes difficult.
I want to learn more about food and travel. And I want to learn French too. Thank you.
Bye,
Muattar Salimova
t12.sampleB1:
Dear LinguaPro Team,

Thank you for your email. I am using your app to learn Spanish, and I think it is quite good. The lessons are interesting, and I like the exercises. They help me to remember new words and grammar.

However, I think some things could be better. For example, the app needs more listening exercises. Also, it would be good if you added more cultural information about Spanish-speaking countries.

I would also like to see more languages available on the app. Maybe you could add Italian or Portuguese?

Overall, I am happy with LinguaPro. Thank you for making a good app.

Sincerely,
Muattar Salimova
t12.sampleB2: Dear LinguaPro Team, Thank you for reaching out to ask how I have been getting on with your app. On the whole, I have been thoroughly impressed. The bite-sized lessons slot neatly into my daily routine, and the speech-recognition feature has done wonders for my pronunciation. I also like how the exercises reinforce new vocabulary without ever feeling dull. That said, there is room for improvement. The grammar explanations can be a little too brief when the topic gets tricky, and the conversation practice occasionally sounds a bit stilted. Going forward, I would love to see live sessions with native speakers, along with more cultural content woven into the lessons. Adding languages such as Arabic would also broaden your appeal. Overall, LinguaPro has made learning genuinely enjoyable, and I look forward to watching it grow. Yours sincerely, Bekzod Aliyev

Umuman olganda, LinguaPro o'rganishni qiziqarli va samarali qildi.

Hurmat bilan,
Muattar Salimova

Biroq, menimcha, ba'zi narsalar yaxshiroq bo'lishi mumkin. Misol uchun, ilovaga ko'proq tinglash mashqlari kerak. Shuningdek, agar siz ispan tilida so'zlashuvchi mamlakatlar haqida ko'proq madaniy ma'lumot qo'shsangiz, yaxshi bo'lardi.

Hurmatli LinguaPro jamoasi,

Til o'rganish dasturingiz bo'yicha tajribam haqida so'raganingiz uchun rahmat. Aytishim kerakki, men uni shu paytgacha umuman olganda ijobiy va qiziqarli vosita deb topdim.

Darslarning tuzilishi mantiqiy va taklif etilayotgan mashqlarning xilma-xilligini qadrlayman. Ayniqsa, lug'at o'rganish bo'limlari menga juda foydali. Biroq, foydalanuvchi tajribasini yanada yaxshilash uchun takomillashtirilishi mumkin bo'lgan sohalar bor deb o'ylayman.

Xususan, dastur talaffuz mashqlari bo'yicha yanada kuchliroq fikr-mulohaza tizimidan foyda ko'radi deb hisoblayman. Hozirgi tizim yetarli bo'lsa-da, batafsil ko'rsatmalar juda qimmatli bo'ladi. Bundan tashqari, foydalanuvchilar o'zaro muloqot qilishlari va mashq qilishlari mumkin bo'lgan hamjamiyat forumining kiritilishi muhim afzallik bo'ladi.

Nihoyat, men yanada ilg'or grammatika modullarini qo'shishni ko'rib chiqishni taklif qilaman, ehtimol, idiomalar va nozik gap tuzilmalariga e'tibor qaratish kerakdir. Bu yuqori darajadagi mahoratga intilayotgan o'rganuvchilarga mos keladi.

E'tiboringiz uchun rahmat. LinguaPro rivojlanishda davom etishini ko'rishni intiqlik bilan kutaman.

Eng yaxshi tilaklar bilan,
Muattar Salimova
